_about: Grade 1 grammar pages (G1-592 to G1-595, types/_shared/grammar-g1.js): capitals for names, days and months; joining words; verb tense. Written by the scratch bank.js of the batch; checked by the factory when it loads.

I sit with {Hana} and {Kai} at lunch.
We go to the library on {Monday}.

On {Tuesday} we go to the pool.
We had a snow day in {January}.
My party is on a {Saturday} in {May}.
I was born on a {Tuesday} in {April}.
